title: Resultant of Concurrent Force Vectors
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Two forces F_1 = <10, -5, 20> and F_2 = <-4, 12, -8> act on a particle. Find the resultant force F and its magnitude.

steps.title: Sum Component-Wise for Resultant Force
steps.explanation: Add corresponding force components according to Newton's law of superposition.

steps.title: Calculate Resultant Magnitude
steps.explanation: Compute the norm of the resultant force vector.
